method: Searched all requested titles and checked primary provider or operator pages where available. Similar titles remain candidates, never substitutions. Provider-demo references do not prove which ZPLAY storefront version was intended.
observationBlocker: Execution environment became unavailable after the CoinsOfAtlantis mobile demo displayed its sound prompt. No game in this batch has 15 confirmed observations. Browser screenshots were attempted under references-27-51/, but their final availability cannot be verified while the workspace is unavailable.

rows.name: Coin Miner

sources.evidence: The provider identifies Coin Miner as a mine game; its original product page describes a 5 by 5 tile grid.

rows.notes: Not a reel slot. The public page contains a DEMO section, but a direct runnable launcher was not extracted.

rows.name: Coins of Atlantis

sources.evidence: Official title page links the public DEMO launcher and describes underwater artwork, expanding wilds and a coin respin feature.

rows.observed: Public launcher loaded the mobile CoinsOfAtlantis iframe and sound prompt using Pixel 7 emulation. No spin was submitted. Sound-prompt interaction stalled before the execution environment became unavailable.

rows.name: Bottle Mania

sources.evidence: Official page describes a single-player crash game with three selectable bottles and a Cash Out control.

rows.notes: This title has bottle/crash rounds, not reels or slot spins. Reference observation should count completed demo rounds.

rows.name: Stars

sources.evidence: Official title page identifies a 3-reel, 3-row, 27-way game, with wilds and a wheel bonus, and links Play Demo.

rows.notes: Official demo link was resolved by web lookup; browser play was not performed. The launcher redirects to games.stage.kajotgames.dev/stars/ with mode=free.

rows.name: Lucky Clover

sources.evidence: Official title page lists five reels, five winning lines, expanding wilds and a Play Online link.

rows.notes: Play Online resolved to the provider's LuckyClover HTML client with a temporary demo token and FUN currency. The ephemeral token is intentionally omitted. No browser play was performed.

rows.name: Lucky Clover 40
rows.notes: Both candidate titles differ from the requested title. No alias relationship to Lucky Clover 40 or a SmartSoft title was verified.

rows.name: Ancient Fortunes
rows.notes: Searches located named entries in an Ancient Fortunes series. A standalone exact-title Ancient Fortunes game and the intended variant were not verified.

rows.name: Ancient Fortunes 40
rows.notes: Exact-name searches returned Ancient Fortunes series games and bet-limit text, without a verified title ending in 40.

rows.name: Magic Apple

sources.evidence: Official product listing identifies Magic Apple as a 5 by 4 game with 30 lines, apple hold-and-win imagery and free spins.

rows.notes: The current product page requires JavaScript. A direct provider demo launcher was not extracted. Secondary sites also list the related Booongo/BNG release; no SmartSoft attribution was verified.

rows.name: Magic Apple 40
rows.notes: Exact-name searches did not verify this title. Magic Apple and Magic Apple 2 are separately published titles; neither was substituted.

rows.name: Fruits 40
rows.notes: Neither the added word Hot nor the singular Fruit was assumed to be an authorized alias for Fruits 40. The list separately requests Fruit 40 at number 44.

rows.name: Cherry 40
rows.notes: Quoted-title searches returned symbol paytable values and differently named cherry games, without a verified exact game title or demo.

rows.name: Sevens 40
rows.notes: A secondary listing uses the reversed word order 40 Sevens. No provider-confirmed alias for Sevens 40 was established.

rows.name: Diamond 40
rows.notes: Quoted-title searches returned unrelated diamond game names or payout values. No exact provider title and demo were verified.

rows.name: Wild 40
rows.notes: Candidate names contain additional words. Neither was substituted for Wild 40.

rows.name: Hot 40

sources.evidence: The game rules identify Hot 40 and AMATIC Industries.
Operator title page offers Play for fun and describes five reels, four rows and 40 lines.

rows.notes: The request repeats Hot 40 at number 67. This research does not establish two distinct games under that same name. No browser demo rounds were performed.

rows.name: Lucky 40

sources.evidence: Operator identifies Lucky 40 by Holland Power Gaming and describes five reels, four rows and 40 fixed lines.
Operator states that its Holland Power Gaming titles include Lucky 40.

rows.notes: The provider's public games page is dynamic and no public free launcher was extracted. The request repeats Lucky 40 at number 69; no second distinct version was established.

rows.name: Fruit 40

sources.evidence: Provider lists Fruit40 / Fruit 40 as a five-reel, three-row video slot with 40 fixed paylines.
Swintt publishes the Fruit 40 feature sheet.

rows.notes: Official Play page was resolved. Its language, currency and jurisdiction controls need a browser before gameplay can be observed.

rows.name: Super Fruits 40
rows.notes: The provider uses 40 Super Fruits, not Super Fruits 40. Word-order equivalence and the requested SmartSoft attribution were not verified.

rows.name: Golden Fruits 40
rows.notes: Only differently named Golden Fruits references were located; the 40 suffix was not verified.

rows.name: Royal 40
rows.notes: Both candidate names differ. No exact Royal 40 provider game or alias relationship was established.

rows.name: Princess 40
rows.notes: Quoted-name searches returned unrelated princess titles and paytable amounts; no exact provider title or demo was verified.

rows.name: Star 40
rows.notes: Quoted-name searches returned symbol values and longer game names, without an exact verified provider title or demo.

rows.name: Lucky Star 40
rows.notes: Quoted-name results included non-game radio equipment; no verified casino game provider title or demo was found.

rows.name: Fortune 40
rows.notes: A secondary page uses caishens-fortune-40 in its URL but identifies a longer different game title. Irrelevant search spam was not treated as a legitimate provider reference.
